name: numaco
description: Numaco AG's public Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: numaco-design
plugins.description: Numaco branded output engine: renders slide decks, statements of work, reports, timesheets, quotations, order confirmations, delivery notes, and invoices to branded PDF.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Markdown review trio (green-mark co-authoring, release QA) plus a dual-vault-sync engine for laptop and mobile Obsidian.

plugins.name: mcp-mail
plugins.description: Self-hosted MCP server giving Claude read and write control over your own mail, calendar, and files across Microsoft 365 (including SharePoint and OneDrive), Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar), IMAP, and a local iCloud or OneDrive folder. Includes verified native Google Docs inline commenting through an authenticated browser. 55 tools; calendar and files are opt-in per account.

plugins.name: dev-process-kit
plugins.description: The development process as a reusable contract architecture: the shared docs tree (docs-vault), the Tier 1 product specification and Definition of Done with a fail-closed identifier gate, and the living project plan.

plugins.name: numaco-hub
plugins.description: Front door for the Numaco plugins: guided setup skill, an on-demand update command, and a skill that opens folders in Obsidian without hanging the app.

plugins.name: clockify-mcp
plugins.description: Local Clockify time tracking for Claude Code and Codex: tools run on this computer, contact Clockify only when used, and keep each user's API key in their OS credential store.
